rules.name: k3s-native-module-construction
rules.timeoutExplanation: One closed native K3s owner segment. The caller retains a total <=60-second transport, payload and cleanup envelope. Dependency acquisition, cache compilation, owner test-binary construction, uncached test execution and native binary stages are separately admitted; a timeout is terminal and requires diagnosis, not a raised wall or blind replay. Native Go and existing BuildKit caches own reuse and native solve cancellation owns remote cleanup; actual cleanup remains separate evidence.

rules.name: k3s-kubernetes-plugin-outline
rules.timeoutExplanation: One selected plugin frontend outline through normal Buildx, with a 20-second payload and one-second cleanup inside the caller total <=60-second transport envelope. It can resolve Dockerfile/session/base-image metadata; it does not execute the product RUN graph or export compiled/test artifacts. A timeout is a terminal diagnostic result, not a reason to replay or raise its wall.
